data.one_liner: Provides custom clipper widgets for ClipPath to create various shapes.
data.what_it_does: The package supplies a collection of ready‑made CustomClipper implementations and message clippers. You can pass these clippers to the clipper property of ClipPath to render custom‑shaped widgets.
use_when: You need predefined shape clippers without writing your own CustomClipper logic
You want quick visual variations for containers, cards, or banners
You prefer a pure‑Flutter solution with no native code
avoid_when: You require animated or interactive clipping
You need high‑performance clipping for large lists or complex scenes
You need platform‑specific features beyond clipping
strengths: Covers many common shapes and message bubbles
weaknesses: Limited to static shapes, no built‑in animation support
May not cover very specialized clipping needs
